chord.title: Bottom chord (part of the edge piece)
rows: nothing drilled; plates are welded on top

stringer.title: Stringer (part of the edge piece)
rows: must stay smooth: no plates or bolt heads on top
top 1 7/8 in above the chord centre

stub.title: Stub (part of the edge piece)
rows: 2 x 5/16 in through both walls, 1/2 in and 2 in from the stringer end
all round to the chord; the stringer sits on top

post.title: Post
rows: 2 x 5/16 in through both walls, 9/16 in and 1 13/16 in from the end
2 x 5/16 in, 9/16 in and 1 9/16 in from the end

floor beam.title: Floor beam
rows: none in the tube (bolts go through the plates and the stub)

post plate.title: Post plate (welded on the edge piece)
rows: 2 x 5/16 in, 1/2 in from the outside edge, 3/4 in and 2 in up from the bottom
bottom edge to the chord top, both faces

diag plate.title: Diagonal plate (welded on the chord)
rows: 1 x 5/16 in, 5/8 in from the end nearer the post, 3/4 in down from the top
2 in from the post centre to the hole
outer face to the chord top

floor beam plate.title: Floor beam plate (welded on the floor beam)
rows: 2 x 5/16 in, 1/2 in and 2 in from the end that laps the stub, centred
top edge, bottom edge and the end

tab.title: Diagonal tab (welded in the tube slot)
rows: two cut off, 1/4 in at 45 degrees, at the hole end
1 x 5/16 in, 3/4 in from the cut end, centred

diagonal.title: Diagonal
rows: 1/8 in wide, 3/4 in deep, through both walls, at each end

bolt.title: Bolt
rows: 1/4 in Grade 8 hex bolt, one nut

jig post.title: Jig: piece of post tube (shop only)
rows: 1 1/4 x 1 1/4 x 0.065 in tube, about 4 in
same as the post bottom: 9/16 in and 1 13/16 in from the end
bolt the post plates to it while welding; reuse

spacer.title: Jig: 5/32 in spacer (shop only)
rows: 5/32 in flat bar (or 1/8 in plate with a 1/32 in shim), 1 x 3 in
keeps the gap between the two diagonal plates while welding

jig stub.title: Jig: piece of stub tube (shop only)
rows: 1 1/4 x 1 1/4 x 0.065 in tube, about 3 3/8 in
bolt the floor beam plates to it while welding; reuse
